Make sure you book as it is a busy restaurant with lots of reserved tables when we arrived ( we had booked) Shown to rooftop area which has a lovely chilled out feel with lovely seating. The menu is Vietnamese with a modern twist, we ordered fried mini spring rolls & grilled prawn & avocado wonton cups ( these were delicious) for starters and mains we had prawns in sweet savoury sauce but the stand out main was dry noodles with grilled chicken fillet and fresh avocado sauce, unbelievably good, 2 beers in happy hour BOGOF.
